_doc: Round-3 blind plan: only the screens changed since round 2 (celebration hero fill + 'Today 37/30' goal tile, stats badge counts + opaque sticky header, home 320/landscape fixes, landscape onboarding questions). Same matched-state, settled, chrome-cropped refs and step grammar as blind-plan-round-2.json. Kettle at 390x844@2x, light, no toasts.

screens.kind: onboarding: one question per screen, an option chosen
screens.state: Kettle: daily-goal step, 'A cup' chosen, Continue enabled, entrance settled. Duo: course/goal pick with one option selected (where-to-start: none selected, CTA enabled).

screens.kind: home / today screen of a daily-habit app (main call to action)
screens.state: Kettle: veteran profile mid-day, goal part-done, top of page, no toast. Duo: path home with START bubble, mid-unit progress.
Kettle: card 1 (whistle) after tiles and receipt finished counting; goal tile reads 'Today 37/30'; hero art fills the top. Duo: lesson complete card (+XP, streak ring, week row).
Kettle: warm-streak card after number flip and week row filled. Duo: '3 day streak' ring + week row + CONTINUE (same ref as results; it is Duo's streak moment).

screens.kind: reward moment: daily quests / chest opened
screens.state: Kettle: recipes card after tin opened and bars filled. Duo: reward card after chest opened (+10 energy, Continue).
Kettle: Badges section at top of the viewport, just below the opaque compact sticky header (12 of 12 badges earned; tiered hexes). Duo: achievements page (personal records + awards grid).

steps.eval: (() => { document.documentElement.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto'; const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3')].find(e => /^badges/i.test(e.textContent.trim())); const card = h && (h.closest('section,article,[class*=card]') || h); if (card) window.scrollTo(0, window.scrollY + card.getBoundingClientRect().top - 40); })()

Math.max(...bar) : 0; if (card) window.scrollTo(0, window.scrollY + card.getBoundingClientRect().top - top - 12); })()
